Rule. Hold this rule for Caching: Cache a hot read, and choose the invalidation story before the hit rate. Say it before you pick a tool from System design.

Why it matters. Interviewers on the System design track listen for whether you can name the idea caching and refuse the common wrong pick. When to use. Use Caching when the prompt's access pattern or force matches the summary above, when a prior slug in its after-list is already in hand, and when saying the rule changes which next step you take.

When to refuse. Refuse Caching when a simpler tool already covers the force, when a prerequisite in after is still missing, or when applying it would invent a mechanism the track never taught. Prefer naming the missing slug over bluffing.
